Engineering Discipline

The Blueprint of Perfection

How a metal fabricator with 15+ years of Ludhiana workshop experience eliminates site surprises, sagging gates, and visible weld seams.

Stage 01 • On-Site

Site Visit & Laser Survey

Inderjit Singh personally visits the location in Punjab or Himachal. Using cross-line optical lasers and electronic angle gauges, we map concrete out-of-square deviations and structural anchor studs before any metal is cut.

✓ Sub-millimeter accuracy
Stage 02 • Technical

CAD Drawings & Alloy Selection

We convert structural requirements into precise fabrication cutting sheets. Material grades (IS 2062 mild steel, SS 304/316, 6063 T6 aluminium, or seasoned teakwood) are selected strictly based on load, span, and climate exposure.

✓ Certified gauge assurance
Stage 03 • The Forge

In-House CNC Cutting & Welding

All primary fabrication takes place inside our dedicated Ludhiana workshop. Heavy hydraulic shearing, fiber laser profile cutting, and high-argon TIG/MIG welding ensure deep weld pool penetration that never cracks under load.

✓ 100% In-house execution
Stage 04 • Finishing

Pre-Assembly & Anti-Rust Coating

Before painting, every piece is dry-fitted on precision welding jigs. Weld seams are blended flush with multi-grit flap discs, treated with zinc-phosphate anti-corrosion wash, and finished with electrostatic powder coating or PU lacquer.

✓ Multi-stage rust barrier
Stage 05 • Delivery

White-Glove On-Site Installation

Our experienced workshop crew handles transportation and mounting. We anchor using heavy-duty Fischer/Hilti chemical fasteners into concrete, calibrate hinge and roller bearings, and clean down all surfaces spotless.

✓ Lifetime alignment support
